dependsOn: open-sse/services/providerParity/native-leonardo-video-image (model ids, size rules, transport helpers and runLeonardoJob, reused read-only)

exports.leonardoImageEditAdapter: default instance; edit({ model, formData, jsonBody, credentials, signal, log })
exports.createLeonardoImageEditAdapter: factory; options { timeoutMs, initTimeoutMs, storageTimeoutMs, dnsTimeoutMs, storageFetch, lookup, baseConnect, submitTimeoutMs, requestTimeoutMs, pollIntervalMs, maxPolls, wait, now } for tests
exports.parseLeonardoEditRequest: ({ model, formData | jsonBody }) -> { generation, reference }; throws status 400/413 before any network call

provider.connectionProxy: refused for edits: the storage upload is pinned and socket-checked and cannot be carried by a proxy

edit.models: same as native-leonardo-video-image image models (phoenix, sdxl, or a platform-model UUID)
edit.size: OpenAI WxH size, else 1024x1024; 32..1536, multiple of 8

storageUpload.url: uploadInitImage.url (validated public https, pinned DNS, peer-checked socket)

accounting.acceptedJob: generation phase only, when the submit outcome is unknown or an accepted job was not seen to fail; never resent
accounting.initAndStorageFailures: no acceptedJob; the result carries phase init-image or storage

integrationPoints.change: for provider leonardo / leo, call leonardoImageEditAdapter.edit({ model, formData, jsonBody, credentials, signal, log }) instead of handleImageEditCore; record usage once on success and keep acceptedJob on errors; pass multipart and JSON bodies unchanged
alternatively, a native-adapter map consulted before getImageEditConfig so the OpenAI multipart passthrough never sees Leonardo
after the native-leonardo-video-image registration, advertise image edits for the image models; no imageEditConfig (the passthrough must not be used)
